response.query: What are the top creative trends in Engineering & Computer Science regarding adaptive models, uncertainty mitigation, real-time verification, and scalable autonomous systems?
response.answer: Top trends include adaptive machine learning models, real-time verification techniques, and scalable autonomous systems for dynamic environments. Uncertainty mitigation through advanced probabilistic methods is also prominent.

results.title: 3.3 Digital Industry | ECS SRIA
results.content: - 1.1 Process Technology, Equipment, Materials And Manufacturing. - 1.4 System of Systems. These technologies include the Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), data analysis, co-robotics, 3D printing and all digital innovations that can be usefully adopted in industry (advancements on sensing, powering, communications, computing, etc… ). Digital Industry is characterized by the increasing integration of the physical world with the digital one by means of the data exploitation provided by an ever more pervasive digitalization. The digitalization allows to move under the same objective heterogeneous topics inherent to the different steps on the lifecycle of the products -like as from the design to the efficiency and the maintenance of the production machineries – involving all aspects of industry and business activities, including workers and the working environment. This Chapter will address the potential for the development of topics such as responsive, smart and sustainable production, Artificial Intelligence (AI) in digital industry, industrial services, digital twins and autonomous systems.
